gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-fs-epilogue: Friendly letters crowd close together in Pramukh Rounded, with big lowercase forms and bowls that tip open toward you. Epilogue is curvier and looser, a wiry monoline.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-fs-supreme: Friendly and tightly packed, Pramukh Rounded keeps its lowercase large and its bowls open. And Supreme, a crisp sans, runs a heavier band of text through the middle.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-general-sans: Neutral but warm, Pramukh Rounded packs its big lowercase tightly together. General Sans, in contrast, fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth curves that glide around every bend, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-cutive: Cutive reads like a typewriter's literary cousin, its classic serif letters spread wide with open c shapes. Oswald brings confident, tightly knit strength to big, short headings.
gen-audiowide-fs-quicksand: Audiowide sets its tall lowercase like spaced-out tiles, futuristic and uniform in its stroke from curve to downstroke. But Quicksand, a soft sans, swells into round bowls with terminals that stop well clear of the stem.
gen-orbitron-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC brings a dignified, literary tone, with gentle stroke modulation and terminals pulled well back. Orbitron, minimal and precise, earns its keep big and short, spreading its letters far apart.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Commanding and distinctive, Oxanium shows off a high x-height and uninterrupted monoline strokes. Be Vietnam Pro follows with curve endings that never crowd each other, so a plain sans text moves along smoothly over many lines.
gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-tera: Ornate meets orderly here. Almendra Display brings a literary flourish and a pronounced x-height. Lexend Tera, a plain sans, answers with plotter-pen lines and letters spaced like stepping stones, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-rokkitt: Rokkitt is bookish and traditional, its serif c as open as a bent paperclip. Chubbo handles casual, inviting display work best, bending marker-tip letters from one length of tubing.
gen-audiowide-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and approachable, with big round lowercase bowls and terminals that stop clear of the stem. Audiowide, with its futuristic tile-like letters, hands over to Nunito, whose rounded sans shapes would carry a longer passage gently.
